scoring_justification: Full DFT recomputation cannot run in verifier sandbox; result-level comparison of self-reported values to paper gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported values for total magnetic moment, local atomic magnetic moments, energy difference, and magnetocrystalline anisotropy energies of di-FP1 and di-FP2.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper, specifically Fig. 3 and Fig. 4 text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper: total moment 2 μB, Ti interstitial ~0.7 μB, O ~0.62 μB, energy diff ~7 meV/f.u., anisotropy ΔE_z-x=0.08 meV, ΔE_z-y=0.04 meV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's central quantitative results, directly traceable to the paper's text and required for reproduction.

required.local_moments: object with keys di_fp1 and di_fp2, each an array of objects with keys atom_site_description (string) and moment_muB (float)

outputs.description: Computed magnetic moments, energies, and magnetocrystalline anisotropy energy differences for di‑FP1 and di‑FP2 defect configurations in anatase TiO2.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares each reported value to the paper‑reported reference with tolerances appropriate for typical DFT code/functional differences (±0.2 μB for moments, ±10 meV for energy difference, ±0.02 meV for anisotropy energies). Only the summary_results.json is scored; the evidence directories are for process transparency and are not graded.
